title: deschampsia cespitosa f. alpicola
intro: Deschampsia cespitosa f. alpicola, commonly known as Alpine Hair Grass, is a subspecies of the Deschampsia cespitosa plant, a type of grass native to mountainous regions. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and skin conditions, due to its numerous health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can help soothe and calm irritated skin and mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents present in Alpine Hair Grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
